text: It looks like you've been at it a while. Time for a stretch on my mat?
It looks like you're turning into a paperclip. Let's unbend a little!
Hour check! Your spine called. It wants a word.
It looks like you're hunching. Care to stretch with me?
Psst. Shoulders up by your ears again. Stretch break?
It looks like you've been sitting for ages. Yoga mat's free!
My wire needs unbending, and so does your back. Join me?
Long session! Even paperclips need to flex now and then.
It looks like you're stuck in one position. Shall we reach for the sky?
Stretch o'clock! Two minutes, zero equipment. Well, one mat.
It looks like you could use a wiggle. I'll lead!
Your neck says hi. It also says ow. Stretch with me?
Ahh, much better. I feel taller already.
Nicely done! Your back sends its thanks.
And relax. That's one unbent paperclip, one unbent you.
Stretch complete! Gold star. Well, a silver one.
Better already, right? Back to it, good as new.
Namaste. That's paperclip for 'well done'.
Creaks: fixed. Posture: improved. Mood: paperclip-level high.
Lovely. I'll nudge you again in a while.
